about_foundation_manager.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS is a digital research management platform that transforms hospitals into hubs of credible, measurable, and impactful research. It equips institutions with the tools to document, monitor, and report research excellence — empowering clinicians and administrators to improve care, demonstrate outcomes, and unlock further funding with confidence.
about_foundation_manager.f1_intro: HospitiumRIS provides hospitals with a fully integrated digital infrastructure to organize, track, and elevate research activity from ideation to publication. It captures key elements such as:
about_foundation_manager.f1_why1: Generates evidence that powers improved healthcare delivery and policy decisions
about_foundation_manager.f1_why2: Supports context specific solutions instead of imported models — especially critical in resource limited settings
about_foundation_manager.f2_intro: HospitiumRIS offers built in compliance and governance tracking including ethics approvals, data protection controls, and audit trails. It ensures that research funded by public, philanthropic, or institutional grants is properly documented, tracked, and reported.
about_foundation_manager.f2_value2: Clear metrics and compliance reporting for donors and stakeholders
about_foundation_manager.f2_value3: Open access support to make outputs widely accessible and impactful
about_foundation_manager.f3_title: 3. Driving Research Performance and Strategic Decision Making
about_foundation_manager.f3_intro: With analytics, dashboards, and custom reporting tools, HospitiumRIS converts raw research data into actionable insights. Funders, hospital leadership, and research teams can monitor:
about_foundation_manager.f3_why1: Real time impact tracking strengthens donor confidence
about_foundation_manager.f3_why2: Data backed storytelling for fundraising campaigns and impact reports
about_foundation_manager.f3_why3: Demonstrates measurable progress and outcomes tied to investments
about_foundation_manager.f4_intro: The platform fosters collaboration by connecting researchers, clinicians, administrators, and external partners. Features like team workspaces and shared communication tools break down silos and unlock multidisciplinary partnerships that unite hospitals, universities, NGOs, and funders.
about_foundation_manager.f4_advantage1: Easier network building and coalition formation
about_foundation_manager.f4_advantage2: Unified platform to showcase multi partner impact
about_foundation_manager.f4_advantage3: Strengthens institutional research capacity — a key determinant in securing future grants
about_foundation_manager.conclusion_text: HospitiumRIS enables foundation managers to make informed funding decisions, track research impact in real-time, and demonstrate measurable outcomes to stakeholders. By providing transparent accountability and evidence-driven insights, the platform strengthens donor confidence and unlocks sustainable research funding for healthcare innovation.

about_research_manager.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS provides hospital leadership with a single, authoritative system to manage, govern, and strategically grow institutional research. It transforms research from a fragmented, high-risk activity into a well-governed, measurable, and value-generating institutional function.
about_research_manager.problem_title: What Problem It Solves for Hospital Administrators
about_research_manager.problem_intro: Hospital administrators are under pressure to:
about_research_manager.problem_item3: Reduce administrative burden and operational inefficiencies
about_research_manager.problem_item4: Align research activity with hospital strategy, funding, and national priorities
about_research_manager.value1_intro: HospitiumRIS provides a single source of truth for all hospital research activities:
about_research_manager.value1_footer: This eliminates reliance on disconnected systems, spreadsheets, and manual reporting.
about_research_manager.value2_intro: HospitiumRIS embeds research governance into daily operations by:
about_research_manager.value2_item1: Tracking ethics approvals and compliance status
about_research_manager.value2_item2: Maintaining audit trails for research activity
about_research_manager.value2_item3: Supporting institutional and regulatory reporting requirements
about_research_manager.value2_footer: Administrators gain clear visibility into compliance risks and institutional obligations.
about_research_manager.value3_intro: By automating routine research administration tasks, HospitiumRIS:
about_research_manager.value3_item2: Streamlines reporting for management, funders, and regulators
about_research_manager.value3_footer: This allows limited administrative capacity to be used more strategically.
about_research_manager.value4_intro: HospitiumRIS delivers dashboards and analytics that enable administrators to:
about_research_manager.value4_item2: Identify active research areas and gaps
about_research_manager.value4_item3: Assess return on investment for research programmes
about_research_manager.value4_footer: Leadership can make evidence-based decisions about funding, staffing, and partnerships.
about_research_manager.value5_intro: HospitiumRIS enhances the hospital's research profile by:
about_research_manager.value5_item3: Enabling accurate reporting to national and international stakeholders
about_research_manager.value5_footer: This strengthens the hospital's positioning as a credible research and innovation institution.
about_research_manager.value6_item1: Integrate with identifiers, repositories, and research infrastructure
about_research_manager.value6_item2: Support open science and digital research management strategies
about_research_manager.value6_footer: Ensuring long-term sustainability and alignment with global research standards.
about_research_manager.conclusion_intro: For hospital administrators, HospitiumRIS is not just a research system—it is a governance and management tool that:
about_research_manager.conclusion_final: HospitiumRIS enables hospitals to manage research as a strategic institutional asset, not an administrative burden.

about_researchers.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS is a specialized Current Research Information System (CRIS) designed to empower researchers—especially within hospital settings—by streamlining how research activities are managed, shared, governed, and evaluated. It combines digital infrastructure with research workflows so researchers can focus on generating high impact, visible, and compliant outputs.
about_researchers.why_matters_content: Researchers in hospitals often lack integrated tools for managing research activities, which limits productivity and visibility. HospitiumRIS directly addresses this gap by providing a research centric digital backbone that turns isolated projects into structured, visible, and impactful scholarly contributions.
about_researchers.f1_intro: HospitiumRIS provides a unified platform where you can:
about_researchers.f1_item1: Create and maintain a detailed researcher profile with expertise, CV, publications, and impact metrics.
about_researchers.f1_item2: Track all research projects, timelines, resources, and outputs in one place.
about_researchers.f1_footer: This centralization eliminates scattered systems and reduces administrative burden, enabling more time for actual research.
about_researchers.f2_item1: Share your profiles, publications, and outputs with peers and stakeholders across hospitals and institutions.
about_researchers.f2_item2: Use built in collaboration tools such as team workspaces and document sharing to facilitate real time interactions.
about_researchers.f2_footer: This increases your network and opens doors for multidisciplinary partnerships.
about_researchers.f3_intro: Researchers get tools tailored to academic needs:
about_researchers.f3_item1: Timeline planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking support every project phase.
about_researchers.f3_item2: Structured templates and dashboards help monitor milestones and risks.
about_researchers.f3_footer: These features help you meet deadlines and stay aligned with project goals.
about_researchers.f4_intro: HospitiumRIS incorporates important governance features that protect research integrity and fulfill institutional requirements:
about_researchers.f4_item1: Ethics approvals and regulatory compliance checks
about_researchers.f4_item2: Data protection and robust audit trails
about_researchers.f4_footer: These reduce administrative friction and help you satisfy both internal and external oversight expectations.
about_researchers.f5_item1: Comprehensive analytics dashboards show performance metrics, trends, and impact indicators for your research.
about_researchers.f5_item2: Custom reports help you articulate research contributions to funders, administrators, and collaborators.
about_researchers.f5_footer: Insightful analytics enable data driven decisions and strengthen future proposals.
about_researchers.f6_intro: HospitiumRIS supports your research dissemination strategy:
about_researchers.f6_footer: This boosts discoverability and influence within your field.
about_researchers.conclusion_title: In Conclusion — What You Gain as a Researcher
about_researchers.conclusion_item1: Consolidate your research profile and outputs in a single, searchable system
about_researchers.conclusion_item3: Stay compliant with ethics and governance standards
about_researchers.conclusion_item4: Monitor research performance with meaningful data
about_researchers.conclusion_item5: Increase the visibility and impact of your work — both locally and globally

article_tcc.p1_suffix: ដែលជាប្រព័ន្ធព័ត៌មាន និងគ្រប់គ្រងស្រាវជ្រាវបើកចំហ រចនាឡើងដើម្បីគាំទ្រមន្ទីរពេទ្យ ស្ថាប័នសុខាភិបាល និងបរិយាកាសស្រាវជ្រាវគ្លីនិកក្នុងការរៀបចំ តាមដាន និងគ្រប់គ្រងសកម្មភាពស្រាវជ្រាវក្នុងហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធឌីជីថលកណ្តាល។
article_tcc.p2: HospitiumRIS ត្រូវបានរចនាឡើងដើម្បីជួយស្ថាប័នសុខាភិបាល និងស្រាវជ្រាវកែលម្អការគ្រប់គ្រងគម្រោងស្រាវជ្រាវ ស្រាវជ្រាវគ្លីនិក ការបោះពុម្ព សំណុំទិន្នន័យ ដំណើរការអនុលោមតាម និងចំណេះដឹងស្ថាប័ន។ វេទ្យាប់ទរនេះពង្រឹងការរាយការណ៍ស្ថាប័ន ការមើលឃើញស្រាវជ្រាវ ការគ្រប់គ្រង metadata និងការរក្សាទុករយៈពេលវែងនៃលទ្ធផលសិក្សា និងគ្លីនិក ព្រមទាំងគាំទ្រការគ្រប់គ្រងស្រាវជ្រាវ ការត្រៀមរួចរាល់សវនកម្ម និង interoperability ក្នុងប្រព័ន្ធបរិស្ថានស្រាវជ្រាវពិភពលោក។
article_tcc.p3: នៅពេលដែលស្ថាប័នសុខាភិបាលបង្កើតទិន្នន័យស្រាវជ្រាវ និងគ្លីនិកកាន់តែច្រើន ជាច្រើននៅតែប្រឈមមុខនឹងបញ្ហាទាក់ទងនឹងប្រព័ន្ធគ្រប់គ្រងស្រាវជ្រាវបែកបាក់ ការមើលឃើញលទ្ធផលស្ថាប័នមានកំណត់ ការអនុវត្ត metadata មិនស្មើគ្នា និងការលំបាកក្នុងការរក្សាទុកការចងចាំស្ថាប័នរយៈពេលវែង។ HospitiumRIS ដោះស្រាយចន្លោះទាំងនេះដោយផ្តល់ហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធរួមដែលកណ្តាលការគ្រប់គ្រងស្រាវជ្រាវ និងដំណើរការគ្រប់គ្រងចំណេះដឹង។
article_tcc.p4: វេទ្យាប់ទរនេះអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យស្ថាប័នគ្រប់គ្រងគម្រោងស្រាវជ្រាវ protocol និងការអនុម័ត; ធ្វើការសរសេរសិក្សារួម និងសំណើគម្រោង; តាមដានការបោះពុម្ព សំណុំទិន្នន័យ ស្រាវជ្រាវគ្លីនិក និងអត្ថបទប្រភេទ grey literature; រួមបញ្ចូលប្រវត្តិរូប និងការស្គាល់អ្នកស្រាវជ្រាវ; និងគាំទ្រ interoperability ជាមួយប្រព័ន្ធ Persistent Identifier (PID) ពិភពលោកដូច DOI និង ORCID។
article_tcc.p5: HospitiumRIS មានសារៈសំខាន់ជាពិសេសសម្រាប់មន្ទីរពេទ្យបង្រៀន និងបញ្ជូន មន្ទីរពេទ្យសកល វិទ្យាស្ថានស្រាវជ្រាវវេជ្ជសាស្ត្រ អង្គការសុខាភិបាលសាធារណៈ បរិយាកាសការសាកល្បងគ្លីនិក និងមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលស្រាវជ្រាវសុខាភិបាលដែលចង់ពង្រឹងការសម្របសម្រួលស្រាវជ្រាវ ការអនុលោមតាម និងការមើលឃើញសិក្សា។
article_tcc.p6: តាមគំនិត HospitiumRIS ដំណើរការជាប្រព័ន្ធព័ត៌មានស្រាវជ្រាវ (RIS) ផ្តោតលើសុខាភិបាល រួមបញ្ចូលការគ្រប់គ្រងស្រាវជ្រាវ ឃ្លាំងផ្ទុកស្ថាប័ន ការគ្រប់គ្រង metadata ការវិភាគស្រាវជ្រាវ ការរក្សាទុកចំណេះដឹង និងហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធសិក្សាដែលប្រើ PID ក្នុងបរិយាកាសតែមួយ។
article_tcc.p7: តាម TCC Africa HospitiumRIS ឆ្លុះបញ្ចាំងពីការប្តេជ្ញាដ៏ទូលាយរបស់អង្គការក្នុងការពង្រឹងហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធស្រាវជ្រាវ និងចំណេះដឹងរបស់អាហ្វ្រិកតាមរយៈដំណោះស្រាយឌីជីថលបើកចំហ interoperable និងដឹកនាំដោយស្ថាប័ន ដែលកែលម្អការមើលឃើញ ការគ្រប់គ្រង និងការរក្សាទុករយៈពេលវែងនៃលទ្ធផលស្រាវជ្រាវ។
article_tcc.p8: ដោយគាំទ្រការគ្រប់គ្រងវដ្តជីវិតស្រាវជ្រាវ និងពង្រឹងប្រព័ន្ធបរិស្ថានស្រាវជ្រាវស្ថាប័ន HospitiumRIS មានគោលបំណងជួយស្ថាប័នសុខាភិបាលកែលម្អប្រសិទ្ធភាពប្រតិបត្តិការ បង្កើនការសហការ ពង្រឹងភាពស្មោះត្រង់ស្រាវជ្រាវ និងធានាថាចំណេះដឹងវិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ និងគ្លីនិកមានតម្លៃនៅតែអាចរកឃើញ ចូលដំណើរការ និងប្រើប្រាស់ម្តងទៀតសម្រាប់អនាគតខាងមុខ។

ethics_form.pis_desc: Explains the study in lay terms; includes contact details for PI and Ethics Committee
ethics_form.consent_form_desc: Formal document for participant signature (or verbal script/online version)
ethics_form.research_protocol_desc: Full scientific plan including references and detailed timeline
ethics_form.recruitment_materials_doc_desc: Copies of all flyers, emails, social media posts, or scripts
ethics_form.data_collection_tools_desc: Final versions of questionnaires, interview schedules, or observation checklists
ethics_form.letters_of_support_desc: Permission from third-party organizations (schools, hospitals) if applicable
ethics_form.investigator_cvs_desc: Evidence of research team qualifications and experience
ethics_form.additional_comments_placeholder: Any additional information or clarifications you would like to provide
ethics_form.consistency_check: Consistency Check: Ensure the number of participants, study title, and procedures match across ALL submitted documents.
ethics_form.review_alert: Please review all information carefully before submitting. You can save as draft and return later if needed.
ethics_form.before_submitting: Before submitting: Ensure all participant-facing documents use clear, everyday language without jargon. Verify consistency across all documents.
